Sales Development Representative

Example Cloud SystemsRemote (US)Posted Sep 12, 2026

RemoteFull-timeEntry LevelDemo listing

About this role

Sample listing for an SDR generating qualified meetings for the account executive team through outbound email, calls and social outreach.

Responsibilities

  • Research target accounts and build prospect lists
  • Run outbound email and calling sequences
  • Qualify inbound enquiries against agreed criteria
  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date

Requirements

  • Confident on the phone and in writing
  • Resilient and comfortable with a daily activity target
  • Coachable and organised
  • No prior sales experience required — training provided

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission
  • Structured promotion path to account executive
  • Full remote setup and tooling

ProspectingCold OutreachCRMCommunicationLead Qualification
